title: Keyphrase languages summary
description: Summary JSON emitted when the keyphrase input sample is split into one JSONL file per language.

input_path.description: Input JSONL path used for the split step.

output_prefix.description: Output folder or S3 prefix containing per-language JSONL files.

language_field.description: Record field used as the language key.

length_field.description: Record field used for length aggregation.

total_records.description: Total number of valid JSONL records written.

total_len.description: Total text length over all records.

invalid_json_lines.description: Number of invalid JSONL lines skipped.

languages.description: Language codes present in the output.

language.description: Language code or safe fallback bucket.

records.description: Number of records for this language.

total_len.description: Total text length for this language.
